    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    (r, c), (tr, tc) = ones[0], twos[0]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    # Follow a diagonal while both coordinates remain more than one cell
    # from the other marker, then finish on the dominant axis, stopping
    # diagonally adjacent to marker 2.
    while abs(tr-r) > 1 and abs(tc-c) > 1:
        r += dr; c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while max(abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)) > 1:
        if abs(tr-r) >= abs(tc-c):
            r += dr
        else:
            c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
